scope: Deploy and release gates: CI required before prod deploy, Railway watchPatterns, fleet-agent image release path, facebook deploy.sh/topology, vendor pin check, version-check/tooling, dependency advisories.

findings.title: deploy.sh, AGENTS.md and README describe a VM topology that no longer exists; a deploy now 'verifies' zero workers and posts 'verified' to Telegram
findings.location: trackers/facebook/scripts/deploy.sh:71-73,78-85,182-210,383-416,431-435; trackers/facebook/AGENTS.md 'Versioning, releases, deploys'; VM 10.10.10.73 docker ps
findings.proposed_fix: Retire or rewrite deploy.sh for the current split: coordinator and console only, workers via push-fleet-images.sh plus the ERP's POST /api/fleet/releases. Make verify fail when it found zero workers. Update AGENTS.md/README/deploy/README.md. Stamp the VM's VERSION and pyprojects consistently (needs owner).
findings.regression_test: test: run deploy.sh's verify with an empty homelab_workers list and assert a non-zero exit.

findings.title: deploy.sh never checks the vendored monitor against VENDOR.md; it ships and builds whatever clone is on disk
findings.proposed_fix: Call `sh scripts/check-vendor.sh` in deploy.sh's version gate, before the rsync.
findings.regression_test: scripts/tests: fixture repo with a vendored clone off-pin; assert deploy.sh's gate step refuses.

findings.title: Merging to main deploys the prod backend (and runs its migrations) without waiting for CI; no branch protection requires a check
findings.location: Railway backend service 26d2f448-d4f2-4f67-b2ef-1628ef27a5c0 source.checkSuites=false (production/main and dev/dev); GitHub branch protection main+dev required_status_checks=null; .github/workflows/backend-tests.yml:11-13; apps/backend/Dockerfile:68
findings.proposed_fix: Add required status checks on main and dev (backend-tests / test, version-check / version-tag-check, deploy-frontend / verify where it applies) with strict up-to-date. Turn on Railway 'Wait for CI' (checkSuites) for backend prod and dev. Correct the backend-tests.yml comment.
findings.regression_test: Throwaway PR to a scratch branch with a deliberately failing test: GitHub refuses the merge, and Railway shows the deployment WAITING until checks pass.

findings.title: The Worker behaviour test never gates a PR; it runs only after merge
findings.proposed_fix: Add the worker.test.mjs step to backend-tests (it is already on its path filter).
findings.regression_test: A PR that edits worker.js to drop X-Client-IP clearing fails backend-tests.

findings.title: Dependency gate is high-only and ERP-only; prod tree carries 6 moderate advisories; tracker dependency trees are never audited
findings.proposed_fix: Refresh nodemailer to >=10.1.4. Add trackers/reddit and a pip-audit of worker-constraints.txt (and of locks to add for the five unpinned services) to the weekly dependency-audit run. Record moderate dispositions next to auditConfig.
findings.regression_test: Weekly dependency-audit run shows three jobs (ERP, reddit, facebook) green.

findings.title: version-check has no concurrency group; two quick dev pushes can tag a version on the wrong commit
findings.regression_test: Two quick pushes are queued one after the other; the second fails with 'Code changed since vX but package.json is still X'.

findings.title: The backend image's defaults fail open when NODE_ENV is missing
findings.proposed_fix: Default the image to NODE_ENV=production and leave secret defaults to docker-compose / the local .env. Or refuse to boot when RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT is set and NODE_ENV is not 'production'.
findings.regression_test: Unit test on buildEnv: RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT set, NODE_ENV unset, so it throws.

findings.title: Ops services drift from the release model and the docs
findings.location: Railway production uptime-monitor source.branch=dev; backup/README.md:3-4 and backup/railway.toml:1 (call the backup service 'db-sync'); Railway pg-r2-backup logs
findings.proposed_fix: Point the uptime-monitor at main (or document it as an exception), fix the service name in the backup docs, and pass `--config /dev/null` or set RCLONE_CONFIG to silence the notice.

findings.title: Prod backend watchPatterns omit package.json / pnpm-lock.yaml / tsconfig.base.json that dev has
findings.proposed_fix: Set prod watchPatterns equal to dev's, ideally through config-as-code (a railway.toml for the backend, so the two environments can't drift).
findings.regression_test: Compare get-service-config watchPatterns for both environments in a CI or ops script; fail on difference.
